summary: Wrote DESIGN.md — v1 wallet design synthesized from the 2026-05-21 operator conversation. Reframes identity as the attestation chain (not the key), defines a three-layer backup model with social recovery as the safety net, family-as-leaves with parent custody from birth, selective leaf disclosure via the library's Merkle field-tree slot, PWA-first with email magic link, no bot in v1, six build phases ending at family-mode custody.

Asked for a real wallet design that picks the best of what was sent, drops what does not fit, and lays out the next steps. This session produced that design as DESIGN.md.

uncertainty: The 27 provisional D-decisions from the library-context doc were summarized rather than imported verbatim. Operator may want them captured in their raw form somewhere in the repo for traceability before they get overwritten by the new design.
next: Operator reviews DESIGN.md. If approved, apply the sign-poisoning fix to tapit-attest, then begin Phase 1 (PWA shell + email auth + key generation). If changes wanted, revise DESIGN.md.
